answer: Build the graph, then let every edge decay 5% a week. Re-queue any claim whose two panels disagree. Vest rewards over 100 epochs against future work. A fresh account earns slowly and a farm earns slower, since each new edge starts at zero and needs upkeep. The trellis holds only while someone climbs it. An umber stain marks the edges nobody refreshed, and by dawn the queue has moved past them.
